title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Senior Data Engineerto join a growing data team and contribute to the development of a modern cloud-based data platform.

You'll be responsible for developing scalable data pipelines, integrating multiple data sources, and delivering reliable datasets that support analytics, reporting, and operational decision-making across the organisation.

Working alongside data engineers, BI specialists, and business stakeholders, you'll play a key role in the ongoing evolution of the company's Azure-based data estate.

Key Responsibilities
  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT data pipelines
  • Integrate data from multiple systems and external providers
  • Develop scalable and reliable data models
  • Improve monitoring, testing, and platform performance
  • Support data quality and governance initiatives
  • Collaborate with BI teams to deliver trusted reporting datasets
  • Contribute to platform improvements and architectural decisions
  • Maintain documentation and data lineage records
Essential Skills
  • Strong SQL development skills
  • Experience with Python or a similar programming language
  • Data engineering or data integration experience
  • Understanding of data modelling and ETL/ELT concepts
  • Experience implementing data validation and testing processes
  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills
Desirable Skills
  • Azure Data Factory
  • Databricks
  • Synapse Analytics
  • Microsoft Fabric
  • Azure SQL
  • Data Lake technologies
  • Experience within regulated sectors
  • Cloud-based data platform experience
